column2: [intro]
I was there, all quiet, in my house,
When I discovered Philippe Katerine, it's not a gift.
His songs make me laugh, it's too funny,
But listening to them all the time makes me a little wary.
I love Philippe Katerine, he's my icon,
But listening on repeat makes me crave a bit.
So I let his CD play,
And I take breaks to stay balanced.
Philippe sings about Barbie dolls,
And about little cats that pee.
I love his crazy humor, it's clear,
But sometimes, I need other music to breathe.
I love Philippe Katerine, he's my icon,
But listening on repeat makes me crave a bit.
So I let his CD play,
And I take breaks to stay balanced.
[ solo ]
Philippe Katerine, you're unique in your style,
Your songs are like a breath of fresh air in winter.
But don't worry, I'll stay your fan,
Even if sometimes, I take a little break, simply.
[outro]
